answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, leveraging a unique identifier, such as an "opal" token, tied to a verifiable resource. Each agent is assigned a "sparrow" node, monitoring and reporting suspicious activity. To establish credibility, an agent must contribute resources to a communal "oasis" pool, making it costly for an attacker to create multiple fake identities, as they must dedicate substantial resources to mimic legitimate agents, thereby deterring large-scale Sybil attacks.
